result.title: Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching
result.summary: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 IW-CFM：用冻结的条件与无条件 flow 模型给出的密度比对条件 flow matching 样本重新加权，使梯度与在 ω-powered 条件分布上的 flow matching 一致，并在合成分布与 ImageNet 上验证其比 matched-guidance CFG 更贴近该目标分布，另附 CLIP 排序分析。
